- Net loss was $183.2M, compared with a net loss of $90.8M in the prior-year quarter; the loss increased 101.8% year over year.
- Diluted loss per share was $1.55, versus $0.81 in 3Q 2025.

- VANQUISH-1 and VANQUISH-2, Phase 3 trials evaluating injectable VK2735 for obesity, completed enrollment. The company said its oral VK2735 Phase 3 SUNRISE program began in October 2026, following Phase 2 results showing weight reductions of up to 12.2% at 13 weeks.

- Agreements with CordenPharma secure expandable manufacturing capacity for active pharmaceutical ingredient and finished product for injectable and oral VK2735.
